properties.name: auth.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the authentication service (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

properties.name: auth.service.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret injected as X-API-Key on internal service-to-service calls (e.g. C2B email validation). Must match AUTH_SERVICE_API_KEY on the auth service. Never used for user-facing Feign calls — those forward the caller's Bearer JWT instead.

properties.name: internal.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret internal services present via X-API-Key when calling wallet-service's /internal/** endpoints (see InternalApiKeyFilter). Must match property-service's app.api-key (INTERNAL_API_KEY env var) — both services read the same INTERNAL_API_KEY name, but from their own separate .env files.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all services.

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute per client before rate limiting kicks in.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.consumer-key
properties.description: M-Pesa Daraja API consumer key.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.consumer-secret
properties.description: M-Pesa Daraja API consumer secret.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa business shortcode (paybill or till number).

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.passkey
properties.description: M-Pesa Lipa Na M-Pesa Online passkey used to generate the STK push password.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.callback-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL that Safaricom will POST STK push callbacks to. Use ngrok locally.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.environment
properties.description: Daraja environment to target: 'sandbox' for testing, 'production' for live.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.certificate-path
properties.description: Path to Safaricom's public X.509 certificate (.cer) used to RSA-encrypt initiator passwords into a SecurityCredential for B2C and B2B (see MpesaSecurityCredentialService). Bare paths (e.g. 'certs/SandboxCertificate.cer') resolve from the classpath — place files under src/main/resources/certs/. Prefix with 'file:' to load from an external path instead (e.g. a mounted secret). Sandbox and production use DIFFERENT certificate files.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.initiator-name
properties.description: M-Pesa B2C API operator username used to initiate business-to-customer disbursements/payouts.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.initiator-password
properties.description: Plaintext M-Pesa B2C API operator password. RSA-encrypted at runtime using mpesa.daraja.certificate-path via MpesaSecurityCredentialService — never sent to Safaricom directly, and no separate security-credential property is needed.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa organization shortcode that money is disbursed from in B2C transactions.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.command-id
properties.description: B2C transaction type: 'SalaryPayment', 'BusinessPayment', or 'PromotionPayment'.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.queue-timeout-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom calls if the B2C request times out in the queue.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.result-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom POSTs the final B2C transaction result to. This — not the initial paymentrequest response — is the actual source of truth for success/failure.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.min-amount
properties.description: Minimum KES amount accepted for a single B2C disbursement. Confirm actual tier limits with Safaricom for your shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2c.max-amount
properties.description: Maximum KES amount accepted for a single B2C disbursement. Confirm actual tier limits with Safaricom for your shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.initiator-name
properties.description: M-Pesa B2B API operator username used to initiate business-to-business transfers.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.initiator-password
properties.description: Plaintext M-Pesa B2B API operator password. RSA-encrypted at runtime using mpesa.daraja.certificate-path via MpesaSecurityCredentialService — never sent to Safaricom directly, and no separate security-credential property is needed.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa organization shortcode that funds move from (payer) in B2B transactions.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.receiver-shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa shortcode of the receiving organization in a B2B transaction.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.command-id
properties.description: B2B transaction type: 'BusinessPayBill', 'BusinessBuyGoods', or 'MerchantToMerchantTransfer'.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.sender-identifier-type
properties.description: Type of shortcode sending funds in a B2B transaction. 4 = organization shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.receiver-identifier-type
properties.description: Type of shortcode receiving funds in a B2B transaction. 4 = organization shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.queue-timeout-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom calls if the B2B request times out in the queue.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.result-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom POSTs the final B2B transaction result to. This — not the initial paymentrequest response — is the actual source of truth for success/failure. Note: B2B is a permissioned Safaricom API; confirm it's enabled for your shortcode before relying on it in production.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.min-amount
properties.description: Minimum KES amount accepted for a single B2B payment. Confirm actual tier limits with Safaricom for your shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.b2b.max-amount
properties.description: Maximum KES amount accepted for a single B2B payment. Confirm actual tier limits with Safaricom for your shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.c2b.shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa business shortcode that C2B validation/confirmation URLs are registered against.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.c2b.response-type
properties.description: Default action Safaricom takes if the validation URL is unreachable: 'Completed' auto-accepts the payment, 'Cancelled' rejects it.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.c2b.validation-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom calls before completing a C2B payment, allowing the transaction to be accepted or rejected. Requires validation to be enabled on the shortcode via Safaricom support.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.c2b.confirmation-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom POSTs completed C2B payment details to.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.initiator-name
properties.description: M-Pesa API operator username used to query the status of a prior transaction. Not yet wired to a service — reserved for automatic reconciliation of stuck B2C/B2B disbursements.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.initiator-password
properties.description: Plaintext M-Pesa API operator password, used to derive the security-credential. Never sent to Safaricom directly.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.security-credential
properties.description: Base64 string of the initiator password encrypted with Safaricom's public X.509 certificate for the target environment.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.party-a
properties.description: Shortcode or MSISDN that the transaction being queried belongs to.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.identifier-type
properties.description: Type of organization receiving the transaction being queried. 1 = MSISDN, 2 = Till Number, 4 = Shortcode.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.queue-timeout-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom calls if the Transaction Status request times out in the queue.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.transaction-status.result-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom POSTs the Transaction Status query result to.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.initiator-name
properties.description: M-Pesa API operator username used for Account Balance / Pull Transactions API requests.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.initiator-password
properties.description: Plaintext M-Pesa API operator password, used to derive the security-credential. Never sent to Safaricom directly.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.security-credential
properties.description: Base64 string of the initiator password encrypted with Safaricom's public X.509 certificate for the target environment.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.shortcode
properties.description: M-Pesa organization shortcode whose account balance or transactions are being queried.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.register-url
properties.description: One-time registration URL submitted to Safaricom to enroll the shortcode for the Pull Transactions API.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.callback-url
properties.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL Safaricom POSTs pulled transaction batches to.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.pull-days
properties.description: Number of days back from today to pull transactions for.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.pull-transactions.offset-value
properties.description: Number of records to skip in the pull transactions result set, used for pagination.

properties.name: stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_test_* for sandbox, sk_live_* for production). Found in the Stripe Dashboard under Developers → API keys.

properties.name: stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_*) used to verify incoming webhook payloads. Found in Stripe Dashboard → Webhooks → your endpoint → Signing secret.

properties.name: paypal.client-id
properties.description: PayPal REST API client ID. Found in the PayPal Developer Dashboard under your app credentials.

properties.name: paypal.client-secret
properties.description: PayPal REST API client secret. Found in the PayPal Developer Dashboard under your app credentials.

properties.name: paypal.environment
properties.description: PayPal environment to target: 'sandbox' for testing, 'production' for live.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend application URL used for CORS allowed-origins configuration.
